is_fee_on_transfer_token.meaning: the token used deducts a percentage on each transfer (fee-on-transfer token)

user_deposits_amount.meaning: amount of tokens the user deposits via increaseTokenBalance(), e.g. 10000 tokens

recorded_balance_after.meaning: creatorBalance recorded by the contract after the deposit (credited full amount parameter)

actual_holdings_after.meaning: actual token holdings of the contract after the deposit (tokens actually received)

assumptions: The deposit scenario is illustrative; the report does not state it was observed in a real transaction.
increaseTokenBalance() is invoked by the depositing user to credit creatorBalance.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the fee percentage applied to the 10000-token deposit, so the exact received amount cannot be derived; the conservation relation is stated symbolically between recorded balance and actual holdings.

limitations: Only the protocol_insolvency impact is formalized; balance_inflation, last_depositor_loss and campaign_funding_failures are handled in separate passes.
The 1% FoT / 1,000,000-token deficit figures belong to last_depositor_loss, not to the selected protocol_insolvency impact, and are not encoded here.
